provenanceNote: RE-ADMITTED 2026-07-29. The previous record pinned sha256 ceaffd30..9dc6ce3b for a 6,094,545-byte JSON export whose download URL was never captured - sourceUrl held only eBible's landing page. That checksum was unverifiable and the corpus unreproducible: a receipt with no way to re-obtain the goods. This record pins eBible's own canonical verse-per-line publication, which has a stable direct URL and can be re-fetched and re-verified by anyone. The text differs from the old export: of the 828 verses previously committed as fixtures, 243 were byte-identical, 390 differed only in typography (straight vs curly quotation marks, which the tokenizer discards), and 195 carried genuine WEB revisions ('put forth grass' -> 'yield grass', 'Let us make man' -> 'Let us make' contracted). The old export was an older revision of the translation.
